name: semctl
synopsis: int semctl(int semid, int semnum, int op, ...);
description: semctl() performs control operations on a System V semaphore set identified by semid. It operates on the specified semaphore number and operation, with an optional fourth argument depending on the operation.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Optional fourth argument of type union semun, depending on op

return_value.success: Returns a nonnegative value depending on the operation; for example, GETVAL returns the semaphore value.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The calling process does not have the required permissions on the semaphore set.
The address pointed to by arg.buf or arg.array isn’t accessible.
Invalid value for op or semid.
The calling process does not have permission for IPC_SET or IPC_RMID.
The value to which semval is to be set is out of range for SETALL or SETVAL.
